title.en: Advancing Evidence for Malaria Elimination in Indonesia
title.id: Advancing Evidence for Malaria Elimination in Indonesia

description.en: CHAMPS and WHO are building evidence on malaria-related deaths through mortality audits and mathematical modelling to inform elimination efforts in Indonesia.
description.id: CHAMPS bersama WHO mengembangkan bukti tentang kematian terkait malaria melalui audit mortalitas dan pemodelan matematis untuk mendukung eliminasi malaria di Indonesia.
